set.body: Scope: revised PRD Phase 9. Introduce namespaced object and representation identities, typed payload roles, a narrow descriptor envelope, distinct archive/representation versions, a pure legacy LNA translator, and the admitted canonical writer. Acceptance: old and new fixtures read; canonical writes emit only the admitted form; unknown representations remain structurally validatable; migration is pure and fixture-tested; logical payload identity is stable across layouts; raw numeric bits are preserved unless the profile declares normalization; injected failure after every proper canonical-write prefix never publishes; external conformance and the frozen numerical corpus remain green.
